title: delphinium carolinianum subsp. vimineum
intro: Delphinium carolinianum subsp. vimineum, commonly known as Carolina larkspur, is a flowering plant species in the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from pain and inflammation. The health benefits of D. carolinianum subsp. vimineum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
